# SynchronizationPathways

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The transition routes or sequences of dynamical states through which coupled oscillators progress toward global synchronization. They reveal how topology and resource constraints shape synchronization in TCC and iNEST systems.
